verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlesu na paripūrakārī hoti, samādhismiṁ na paripūrakārī, paññāya na paripūrakārī.
verses.english: One individual has not fulfilled ethics, immersion, or wisdom.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti, samādhismiṁ na paripūrakārī, paññāya na paripūrakārī.
verses.english: One individual has fulfilled ethics, but not immersion or wisdom.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti, samādhismiṁ paripūrakārī, paññāya na paripūrakārī.
verses.english: One individual has fulfilled ethics and immersion, but not wisdom.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti, samādhismiṁ paripūrakārī, paññāya paripūrakārī.
verses.english: One individual has fulfilled ethics, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”
